title: Train on the toy corpus
notes: From the seed's 16 longer pieces, three rounds of pruning leave 8: the, at, cat, dog, sa, alk, an and alked. Round 1 removes lk, og, do and ca, which no best split uses. After training, walking is w alk i n g and talked is t alked (−6.65).
